lines.trans: I have fixed boilers, locks, and clocks, madam, but never a piano.
A piano is just good wood, wool felt, and steel string, Mateo.

words.gloss: to be (identity, origin, time, permanent trait)

lines.trans: Press the key on the left first so we see how a healthy hammer rises.
Watch C rise smoothly and strike the three strings: clean and clear.
Now press the silent key right next to it.
Look: the key goes down, but the little wooden hammer leans to one side!
Bring the lamp closer: the tiny brass pin slipped halfway out of the wood!
Wait... nothing is broken! The damp air thirty years ago only loosened the felt!
Can you seat such a tiny pin without splitting the wood, Mateo?
Give me good light, thin tweezers, and dry glue tomorrow morning.
Once that hammer stands straight, will you be able to tune the whole middle octave, Carmen?
Do you have a tuning key in the chest, Mateo? Look in the bottom drawer!
I have fixed boilers, locks, and clocks, madam, but never a piano.
A piano is just good wood, wool felt, and steel string, Mateo.

meanings.note: Marks destination, clock time, and animate direct objects (personal a).

examples.text: Vamos a la estación ahora.
examples.trans: We are going to the station now.

examples.text: El desayuno empieza a las ocho.
examples.trans: Breakfast starts at eight o'clock.

meanings.note: Indicates position or movement downward.

examples.text: La cocina está abajo.
examples.trans: The kitchen is downstairs.

examples.text: Te espero abajo en el patio.
examples.trans: I will wait for you downstairs in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Regular -ir verb with irregular past participle abierto.

examples.text: Abro la ventana por la mañana.
examples.trans: I open the window in the morning.

examples.text: Ayer abrimos la tienda temprano.
examples.trans: Yesterday we opened the shop early.

acercar.gloss: to bring closer; to move closer

meanings.en: to bring closer; to move closer
meanings.note: Spelling changes c -> qu before -e (acerqué, acerque).

examples.text: Acerca la lámpara a la mesa de trabajo, por favor.
examples.trans: Bring the lamp closer to the workbench, please.

examples.text: Acercamos dos sillas de madera junto al piano.
examples.trans: We move two wooden chairs closer to the piano.

meanings.note: Strong metal alloy used in piano strings, tools, and kitchenware.

examples.text: Las cuerdas agudas del piano son de acero fino.
examples.trans: The high piano strings are made of thin steel.

examples.text: Guarda los tornillos de acero en esta caja pequeña.
examples.trans: Keep the steel screws in this small box.

meanings.note: Regular -ar verb; llave de afinar is a piano tuning wrench.

examples.text: Carmen afina el piano de madera antes del viernes.
examples.trans: Carmen tunes the wooden piano before Friday.

examples.text: Afinamos cada cuerda con mucha paciencia y silencio.
examples.trans: We tune every string with great patience and quiet.

meanings.note: Opposite of apretar (to tighten).

examples.text: Aflojo el tornillo con cuidado.
examples.trans: I loosen the screw carefully.

examples.text: El mecánico aflojó la tuerca vieja.
examples.trans: The mechanic loosened the old nut.

meanings.note: Ahora mismo means 'right now'.

examples.text: Voy para allá ahora mismo.
examples.trans: I am heading there right now.

examples.text: Ahora tenemos cuatro mesas libres.
examples.trans: Now we have four free tables.

meanings.note: Al aire libre means 'outdoors'.

examples.text: Abre la ventana, necesitamos aire fresco.
examples.trans: Open the window, we need fresh air.

examples.text: El aire del mar es muy limpio.
examples.trans: The sea air is very clean.

meanings.note: Mandatory contraction of preposition a + masculine article el; al + infinitive means 'upon doing'.

examples.text: Vamos al mercado por la mañana.
examples.trans: We go to the market in the morning.

examples.text: Al abrir la puerta, sonó el timbre.
examples.trans: Upon opening the door, the bell rang.

arreglar.gloss: to fix; to repair; to tidy

meanings.en: to fix; to repair; to tidy
meanings.note: Everyday verb for repairing things or sorting out problems.

examples.text: El vecino arregla la lámpara del salón.
examples.trans: El vecino fixes the lounge lamp.

examples.text: Ayer arreglamos la puerta del jardín.
examples.trans: Yesterday we repaired the garden gate.

meanings.note: Tener ... años expresses age; hace ... años means '... years ago'.

examples.text: Tengo treinta años.
examples.trans: I am thirty years old.

examples.text: Este año vamos a la playa en julio.
examples.trans: This year we're going to the beach in July.

bajar.gloss: to go down; to bring down; to lower

meanings.en: to go down; to bring down; to lower
meanings.note: Works both intransitively (go downstairs) and transitively (bring down).

examples.text: Bajo a la cocina a preparar té.
examples.trans: I go down to the kitchen to make tea.

examples.text: Bajamos las maletas por la escalera.
examples.trans: We bring the suitcases down the stairs.

meanings.note: Written accent marks hiatus a-ú; plural los baúles.

examples.text: Hay un baúl antiguo de madera en el ático.
examples.trans: There is an old wooden chest in the attic.

examples.text: Guardamos las mantas limpias dentro del baúl.
examples.trans: We keep the clean blankets inside the chest.

meanings.note: Shortens to buen before masculine singular nouns (buen viaje); ¡Buenos días! = Good morning!

examples.text: ¡Buenos días a todos!
examples.trans: Good morning, everyone!

examples.text: Hace muy buen tiempo hoy.
examples.trans: The weather is very nice today.

meanings.note: Plural cajones.

examples.text: El cajón está aquí.
examples.trans: The drawer is here.

examples.text: Vemos los cajones desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the drawers from the door.

meanings.note: Heating and hot-water boiler.

examples.text: La caldera está aquí.
examples.trans: The boiler is here.

examples.text: Vemos las calderas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the boilers from the door.

meanings.note: Same form for masculine and feminine; el re central = middle D.

examples.text: La estación central está cerca.
examples.trans: The central station is close.

examples.text: Busco la plaza central del barrio.
examples.trans: I'm looking for the main square of the neighbourhood.

meanings.note: Door or box lock.

examples.text: La llave no entra en la cerradura.
examples.trans: The key won't go into the lock.

examples.text: Cambiamos la cerradura de la puerta.
examples.trans: We are changing the lock on the door.

meanings.note: Alto y claro = loud and clear; ¡Claro! / ¡Pues claro! = Of course!

examples.text: El mensaje es alto y claro.
examples.trans: The message is loud and clear.

examples.text: ¡Pues claro que puedes pasar!
examples.trans: Well of course you can come in!

meanings.note: Cola de carpintero / cola blanca is wood glue; hacer cola means 'to queue'.

examples.text: Mateo usa cola seca para fijar el fieltro.
examples.trans: Mateo uses dry glue to secure the felt.

examples.text: Deja secar la cola de madera toda la noche.
examples.trans: Let the wood glue dry all night.

colocar.gloss: to place; to set out; to fit in place

meanings.en: to place; to set out; to fit in place
meanings.note: Spelling changes c -> qu before -e (coloqué).

examples.text: Colocamos cuatro sillas alrededor de cada mesa redonda.
examples.trans: We set out four chairs around each round table.

examples.text: Coloca el pasador con cuidado usando las pinzas.
examples.trans: Fit the pin carefully using the tweezers.

meanings.note: Unaccented in statements and time clauses (interrogative: cuándo).

examples.text: Avísame cuando llegue el taxi.
examples.trans: Let me know when the taxi arrives.

examples.text: Cuando llueve, huele a tierra mojada.
examples.trans: When it rains, it smells like wet earth.

meanings.note: Used for piano or guitar strings as well as rope.

examples.text: El macillo golpea tres cuerdas de acero a la vez.
examples.trans: The hammer strikes three steel strings at once.

examples.text: Esa cuerda central suena clara después de afinarla.
examples.trans: That middle string sounds clear after tuning it.

meanings.note: Interrogative adverb with written accent.

examples.text: ¿Cómo se llama usted?
examples.trans: What is your name?

examples.text: ¿Cómo encuentro la ferretería?
examples.trans: How do I find the hardware shop?

dar.gloss: to give; to face onto (dar a); to strike (the hour)

meanings.en: to give; to face onto (dar a); to strike (the hour)
meanings.note: Irregular 1st sg doy and preterite di/dio; dar las doce = strike twelve.

examples.text: La ventana da al patio soleado.
examples.trans: The window looks out onto the sunny courtyard.

examples.text: El reloj acaba de dar las doce.
examples.trans: The clock has just struck twelve.

meanings.note: Links possession, origin, material (de madera), and contents (taza de té).

examples.text: Es una mesa redonda de madera.
examples.trans: It is a round wooden table.

examples.text: Vengo de la estación de tren.
examples.trans: I am coming from the train station.

meanings.note: First note of the solfège scale (do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, si).

examples.text: El do suena limpio y redondo en esta octava.
examples.trans: C sounds clean and round in this octave.

examples.text: Empieza la escala despacio desde el do central.
examples.trans: Start the scale slowly from middle C.

meanings.note: Definite article; also appears before feminine nouns starting with stressed /a/ (el agua, el asa).

examples.text: El patio tiene mucha luz.
examples.trans: The courtyard has plenty of light.

examples.text: Pásame el libro de reservas.
examples.trans: Pass me the reservation book.

meanings.note: Expresses location inside or on top of a surface (en la mesa = on the table).

examples.text: Las tazas están en la mesa.
examples.trans: The cups are on the table.

examples.text: Vivimos en Valencia todo el año.
examples.trans: We live in Valencia all year.

meanings.note: Forms: ese, esa, esos, esas.

examples.text: Pásame ese cuaderno azul.
examples.trans: Pass me that blue notebook.

examples.text: Esa maleta pertenece a un cliente.
examples.trans: That suitcase belongs to a guest.

esperar.gloss: to wait; to wait for; to hope

meanings.en: to wait; to wait for; to hope
meanings.note: Covers both 'wait (for)' and 'hope'.

examples.text: Espere un momento, por favor.
examples.trans: Wait a moment, please.

examples.text: Esperamos que descanse muy bien.
examples.trans: We hope you rest very well.

meanings.note: Pairs with locations (está en el patio) and temporary states (está caliente).

examples.text: El desayuno ya está listo.
examples.trans: Breakfast is ready now.

examples.text: ¿Dónde están las llaves de latón?
examples.trans: Where are the brass keys?

meanings.note: Dense wool fabric used on piano hammers and under chair legs.

examples.text: El fieltro blanco suaviza el golpe sobre la cuerda.
examples.trans: The white felt softens the strike on the string.

examples.text: Pegamos discos de fieltro debajo de las doce sillas.
examples.trans: We glued felt pads underneath all twelve chairs.

meanings.note: Describes thin glass/fabric as well as fine quality.

examples.text: El cristal de estos vasos es demasiado fino para el té.
examples.trans: The glass of these cups is too thin for tea.

examples.text: Corta el limón en rodajas muy finas.
examples.trans: Cut the lemon into very thin slices.

golpear.gloss: to bump; to knock; to hit

meanings.en: to bump; to knock; to hit
meanings.note: Regular -ar verb.

examples.text: No golpees la pared con la caja.
examples.trans: Do not bump the wall with the box.

examples.text: La rama golpeaba suavemente el cristal.
examples.trans: The branch tapped gently against the windowpane.

meanings.note: Impersonal present form hay means 'there is / there are'; haber que + infinitive = must / need to.

examples.text: Hay pan caliente en la cocina.
examples.trans: There is warm bread in the kitchen.

examples.text: Ya hemos preparado las habitaciones.
examples.trans: We have already prepared the rooms.

hacer.gloss: to do; to make; ago (hace + time)

meanings.en: to do; to make; ago (hace + time)
meanings.note: Irregular: hago, hice, hecho; hace tres años = three years ago.

examples.text: La panadera hace pan fresco cada mañana.
examples.trans: The baker bakes fresh bread every morning.

examples.text: Llegó hace diez minutos.
examples.trans: She arrived ten minutes ago.

meanings.note: Indicates direction of movement or gaze.

examples.text: Camina hacia el puente de piedra.
examples.trans: Walk toward the stone bridge.

examples.text: Sigue mirando hacia la esquina.
examples.trans: Keep looking toward the corner.

meanings.note: Proparoxytone (esdrújula), so it always keeps its written accent.

examples.text: El aire húmedo del mar entra por el balcón.
examples.trans: Damp sea air comes in through the balcony.

examples.text: Pasa primero un paño húmedo sobre la pizarra.
examples.trans: Run a damp cloth across the board first.

meanings.note: A la izquierda = on/to the left.

examples.text: La izquierda está aquí.
examples.trans: The left is here.

examples.text: Vemos las izquierdas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the lefts from the door.

meanings.note: Justo aquí = right here; justo al lado = right next door.

examples.text: La llave está justo aquí.
examples.trans: The key is right here.

examples.text: La panadería queda justo al lado.
examples.trans: The bakery is right next door.

meanings.note: Definite feminine singular article before nouns; direct-object feminine pronoun before/attached to verbs.

examples.text: La puerta del patio es azul.
examples.trans: The courtyard door is blue.

examples.text: La habitación tiene mucha luz.
examples.trans: The room has plenty of light.

meanings.note: Al lado = on the side / next door.

examples.text: Siéntate a mi lado.
examples.trans: Sit next to me.

examples.text: La farmacia está al lado del banco.
examples.trans: The pharmacy is next to the bank.

meanings.note: De lana = woollen.

examples.text: La lana es muy importante aquí.
examples.trans: The wool is very important here.

examples.text: Hablamos sobre la lana.
examples.trans: We talk about the wool.

meanings.note: Used with feminine plural nouns and clock hours (las ocho).

examples.text: Las ventanas dan al jardín.
examples.trans: The windows face the garden.

examples.text: Desayunamos a las ocho.
examples.trans: We have breakfast at eight.

meanings.note: Yellow copper-zinc alloy used for keys, lamps, and valves.

examples.text: La lámpara es de latón.
examples.trans: The lamp is made of brass.

examples.text: Limpio el pomo de latón cada semana.
examples.trans: I polish the brass knob every week.

meanings.note: Opposite of sucio (dirty).

examples.text: La habitación ya está limpia.
examples.trans: The room is already clean.

examples.text: Necesito una toalla limpia.
examples.trans: I need a clean towel.

meanings.note: Versatile everyday noun for door keys, shut-off valves, and spanners.

examples.text: ¿Me das la llave de la habitación?
examples.trans: Can you give me the room key?

examples.text: He perdido las llaves de casa.
examples.trans: I've lost my house keys.

meanings.note: Plural las luces; a plena luz del sol = in bright sunlight.

examples.text: La luz está aquí.
examples.trans: The light is here.

examples.text: Vemos las luces desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the lights from the door.

meanings.note: Table, ceiling, or reading lamp.

examples.text: Enciende la lámpara, por favor.
examples.trans: Turn on the lamp, please.

examples.text: Hay una lámpara antigua en el salón.
examples.trans: There's an old lamp in the living room.

meanings.note: Diminutive of mazo ('mallet'); standard Spanish term for a felt piano hammer.

examples.text: Cada tecla levanta su propio macillo cubierto de fieltro.
examples.trans: Each key lifts its own felt-covered hammer.

examples.text: El macillo vuelve recto a su sitio después del arreglo.
examples.trans: The hammer returns straight to its place after the repair.

meanings.note: De madera = wooden.

examples.text: La mesa es de madera.
examples.trans: The table is made of wood.

examples.text: Me gusta el olor de la madera.
examples.trans: I like the smell of wood.

meanings.note: La mañana = the morning; mañana (without article) = tomorrow.

examples.text: Por la mañana servimos café caliente.
examples.trans: In the morning we serve hot coffee.

examples.text: ¡Hasta mañana a las ocho!
examples.trans: See you tomorrow at eight!

meanings.note: Media vuelta = half-turn (turn around); medio vaso = half a glass.

examples.text: Es una pieza media.
examples.trans: It is a half piece.

examples.text: Oh, qué amable es usted, señor. Solo medio vaso.
examples.trans: Oh, how kind you are, sir. Just half a glass.

mirar.gloss: to look; to look at; to watch

meanings.en: to look; to look at; to watch
meanings.note: Needs no preposition for 'at' (mira el reloj = look at the clock).

examples.text: Mira qué sol hace esta mañana.
examples.trans: Look how sunny it is this morning.

examples.text: Miramos el mapa antes de salir.
examples.trans: We look at the map before going out.

meanings.note: Describes a piano key that makes no sound or a silent letter (la hache muda).

examples.text: Mañana arreglaremos la única tecla muda del teclado.
examples.trans: Tomorrow we will fix the single silent key on the keyboard.

examples.text: Todos se quedaron mudos al ver la sala iluminada.
examples.trans: Everyone was left speechless seeing the lit room.

nada.gloss: nothing; not at all (de nada = you're welcome)

meanings.en: nothing; not at all (de nada = you're welcome)
meanings.note: No pasa nada = no problem; nada de... = no ... at all.

examples.text: Tranquilo, no pasa nada.
examples.trans: Easy now, there is no problem at all.

examples.text: No queda nada de mantequilla.
examples.trans: There is no butter left at all.

nos.gloss: us; to us; each other (¡Nos vemos!)

meanings.en: us; to us; each other (¡Nos vemos!)
meanings.note: First-person plural object/reflexive/reciprocal pronoun.

examples.text: ¡Nos vemos mañana por la mañana!
examples.trans: See you tomorrow morning!

examples.text: Nos alegra mucho la noticia.
examples.trans: The news makes us very glad.

meanings.note: Precede the verb alone (nunca llega tarde) or follow no.

examples.text: Nunca he visto ese cofre antes.
examples.trans: I have never seen that chest before.

examples.text: El tren de la mañana nunca llega tarde.
examples.trans: The morning train never arrives late.

meanings.note: Eight-note musical interval from one note to the next of the same name.

examples.text: Toca la misma melodía una octava más arriba.
examples.trans: Play the same melody one octave higher.

examples.text: Ya hemos afinado toda la octava central del piano.
examples.trans: We have already tuned the piano's entire middle octave.

meanings.note: Marks destination, recipient (para ti), deadline, and minutes to the hour (cinco para las doce).

examples.text: Este paquete blanco es para mi hermano.
examples.trans: This white parcel is for my brother.

examples.text: Faltan diez minutos para las doce.
examples.trans: It is ten minutes to twelve.

meanings.note: Plural pasadores; small metal pivot pin inside a hinge or piano action.

examples.text: El pasador de latón sujeta la pieza de madera.
examples.trans: The brass pin holds the wooden part in place.

examples.text: Empuja el pasador fino con la punta de las pinzas.
examples.trans: Push the thin pin in with the tip of the tweezers.

meanings.note: Hermano pequeño = younger brother; de pequeño = as a child.

examples.text: Tengo un piso pequeño.
examples.trans: I have a small flat.

examples.text: Mi hermana pequeña tiene diez años.
examples.trans: My little sister is ten.

meanings.note: Core contrast conjunction.

examples.text: Hace frío fuera, pero dentro se está bien.
examples.trans: It is cold outside, yet inside it is cosy.

examples.text: Es pequeño, pero tiene mucha luz.
examples.trans: It is small, but it has lots of light.

meanings.note: Tocar el piano = to play the piano.

examples.text: Mi hija toca el piano.
examples.trans: My daughter plays the piano.

examples.text: Hay un piano viejo en el salón.
examples.trans: There's an old piano in the living room.

meanings.note: Usually plural (unas pinzas) when referring to precision tweezers.

examples.text: Necesito unas pinzas finas para sujetar el pasador.
examples.trans: I need thin tweezers to hold the pin.

examples.text: Guarda las pinzas pequeñas en el bolsillo del maletín.
examples.trans: Keep the small tweezers in the toolkit pocket.

poder.gloss: can; to be able to; may

meanings.en: can; to be able to; may
meanings.note: Irregular: puedo, pude, podría.

examples.text: ¿Puedo ver la etiqueta otra vez?
examples.trans: May I look at the tag again?

examples.text: Hoy podemos desayunar en el patio.
examples.trans: Today we can have breakfast in the courtyard.

por.gloss: through; along; by; because of; in (time of day)

meanings.en: through; along; by; because of; in (time of day)
meanings.note: Por la mañana = in the morning; por favor = please; gracias por = thanks for.

examples.text: Paseamos por el casco antiguo.
examples.trans: We stroll through the old quarter.

examples.text: Por la mañana entra mucho sol.
examples.trans: In the morning plenty of sun comes in.

meanings.note: Shortens to primer before masculine singular nouns (el primer día); also used as adverb ('first').

examples.text: Hoy es mi primer día de trabajo.
examples.trans: Today is my first day of work.

examples.text: La primera habitación está libre.
examples.trans: The first room is vacant.

pulsar.gloss: to press; to push (a button or switch)

meanings.en: to press; to push (a button or switch)
meanings.note: Regular -ar verb.

examples.text: Pulsa el timbre de latón si la puerta está cerrada.
examples.trans: Press the brass bell if the door is closed.

examples.text: Clara pulsó el interruptor y se encendió la luz.
examples.trans: Clara pressed the switch and the light came on.

quedar.gloss: to remain / be left; to suit; to meet up (Spain); to stay (quedarse)

meanings.en: to remain / be left; to suit; to meet up (Spain); to stay (quedarse)
meanings.note: Versatile verb: quedan dos ('two left'), le queda bien ('suits you'), quedar al mediodía ('meet at noon'), quedarse ('stay').

examples.text: Solo quedan dos habitaciones libres.
examples.trans: Only two vacant rooms are left.

examples.text: Esa chaqueta te queda muy bien.
examples.trans: That jacket suits you very well.

meanings.note: Sigue todo recto = go straight ahead.

examples.text: Es una pieza recta.
examples.trans: It is a straight piece.

examples.text: A la izquierda en la puerta, todo recto hasta el puente. ¿Cruzo el río?
examples.trans: Left at the gate, straight ahead to the bridge. Do I cross the river?

meanings.note: Covers wristwatches, wall clocks, and church tower clocks (plural: relojes).

examples.text: El reloj está aquí.
examples.trans: The watch is here.

examples.text: Vemos los relojes desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the watchs from the door.

meanings.note: Regular verb with irregular past participle roto.

examples.text: Ten cuidado de no romper la taza.
examples.trans: Be careful not to break the cup.

examples.text: El viento rompió una rama seca.
examples.trans: The wind snapped a dry branch.

salir.gloss: to go out; to come out; to leave

meanings.en: to go out; to come out; to leave
meanings.note: Irregular 1st sg salgo; salir corriendo = run out.

examples.text: El pan acaba de salir del horno.
examples.trans: The bread just came out of the oven.

examples.text: Salgo temprano hacia la estación.
examples.trans: I leave early for the station.

sano.gloss: healthy; sound (sano y salvo = safe and sound)

meanings.en: healthy; sound (sano y salvo = safe and sound)
meanings.note: Sanas y salvas agrees with feminine plural nouns like tazas.

examples.text: Es una pieza sana.
examples.trans: It is a healthy piece.

examples.text: Ahí mismo, en la frente, sanas y salvas.
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, safe and sound.

se.gloss: himself / herself / yourself / themselves; impersonal one

meanings.en: himself / herself / yourself / themselves; impersonal one
meanings.note: Reflexive, reciprocal, passive/impersonal pronoun, and indirect object le/les before lo/la.

examples.text: La puerta se abre despacio.
examples.trans: The door opens slowly.

examples.text: Aquí se oye el canto de los pájaros.
examples.trans: Here you can hear the birds singing.

meanings.note: Toallas secas = dry towels.

examples.text: La ropa ya está seca.
examples.trans: The clothes are already dry.

examples.text: Prefiero el vino seco.
examples.trans: I prefer dry wine.

ser.gloss: to be (identity, origin, time, permanent trait)

meanings.en: to be (identity, origin, time, permanent trait)
meanings.note: Used for names, professions, ownership (es mía), materials (es de madera), and clock time.

examples.text: Soy arquitecta y vivo en Valencia.
examples.trans: I am an architect and live in Valencia.

examples.text: Esa maleta azul es mía.
examples.trans: That blue suitcase is mine.

meanings.note: Polite form of address: señora Carmen.

examples.text: Buenos días, señora.
examples.trans: Good morning, madam.

examples.text: La señora García vive en el tercero.
examples.trans: Mrs García lives on the third floor.

meanings.note: Followed by bare nouns (sin azúcar, sin sal) or infinitives (sin abrir = unopened).

examples.text: Tomo el té sin azúcar, gracias.
examples.trans: I take my tea without sugar, thank you.

examples.text: Salió de casa sin abrigo.
examples.trans: He left home without a coat.

solo.gloss: only; just (also adj solo/sola = alone / single)

meanings.en: only; just (also adj solo/sola = alone / single)
meanings.note: Unaccented in modern RAE spelling; café solo = black espresso.

examples.text: Solo necesito cinco minutos más.
examples.trans: I only need five more minutes.

examples.text: Queda una sola habitación libre.
examples.trans: Only a single room remains vacant.

meanings.note: Same form for masculine and feminine.

examples.text: La toalla es muy suave.
examples.trans: The towel is very soft.

examples.text: Pon una música suave, por favor.
examples.trans: Put on some soft music, please.

subir.gloss: to go up; to climb; to carry upstairs

meanings.en: to go up; to climb; to carry upstairs
meanings.note: Works both intransitively and transitively.

examples.text: Subo las toallas limpias a la primera planta.
examples.trans: I carry the clean towels up to the first floor.

examples.text: Subieron despacio la escalera de madera.
examples.trans: They climbed the wooden stairs slowly.

meanings.note: Shortened form of tanto used before adjectives and adverbs (¡qué mañana tan luminosa!).

examples.text: ¡Qué patio tan tranquilo!
examples.trans: What a peaceful courtyard!

examples.text: ¿Por qué sale el agua tan fría?
examples.trans: Why is the water running so cold?

meanings.note: A door key is la llave; a piano key is la tecla.

examples.text: Esta tecla del ordenador no funciona.
examples.trans: This computer key doesn't work.

examples.text: El piano tiene teclas blancas y negras.
examples.trans: The piano has white and black keys.

tener.gloss: to have; to have to (tener que + inf)

meanings.en: to have; to have to (tener que + inf)
meanings.note: Used in idioms: tener hambre/frío/miedo/prisa/razón; tener que = must.

examples.text: Tenemos ocho habitaciones tranquilas.
examples.trans: We have eight quiet rooms.

examples.text: Tengo que cerrar la ventana ahora.
examples.trans: I have to close the window now.

tocar.gloss: to touch; to ring (a bell); to play (an instrument)

meanings.en: to touch; to ring (a bell); to play (an instrument)
meanings.note: Preterite 1st sg spells c -> qu: toqué.

examples.text: Alguien acaba de tocar el timbre.
examples.trans: Someone just rang the bell.

examples.text: De niño tocaba el piano los viernes.
examples.trans: As a boy he played the piano on Fridays.

meanings.note: Todo el día = the whole day; todo el mundo = everyone; sobre todo = mostly.

examples.text: Todo está limpio y en su sitio.
examples.trans: Everything is clean and in its place.

examples.text: Camina todo recto por esta calle.
examples.trans: Walk straight ahead down this street.

torcer.gloss: to twist; to lean; to bend (torcerse = go crooked)

meanings.en: to twist; to lean; to bend (torcerse = go crooked)
meanings.note: Stem-changing o -> ue (tuerzo, tuerce) and c -> z before o/a.

examples.text: Si el pasador está flojo, la pieza se tuerce.
examples.trans: If the pin is loose, the part leans sideways.

examples.text: No tuerzas la llave antigua dentro de la cerradura.
examples.trans: Do not twist the old key inside the lock.

meanings.note: Treinta y cinco = thirty-five.

examples.text: Nos dan treinta días de plazo.
examples.trans: They give us thirty days' notice.

examples.text: Son las nueve y treinta y cinco.
examples.trans: It is nine thirty-five.

meanings.note: Invariable cardinal number.

examples.text: Ponemos tres mesas bajo el árbol.
examples.trans: We set three tables under the tree.

examples.text: Empieza con tres frases cortas.
examples.trans: Start with three short sentences.

meanings.note: Forms: un (m sg), una (f sg), unos (m pl 'some/about'), unas (f pl).

examples.text: Quiero un café caliente, por favor.
examples.trans: I would like a hot coffee, please.

examples.text: Hay una mesa libre en el patio.
examples.trans: There is a free table in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Irregular: veo, vi, visto.

examples.text: Desde aquí veo el puente de piedra.
examples.trans: From here I see the stone bridge.

examples.text: ¡Nos vemos luego en el patio!
examples.trans: See you later in the courtyard!

meanings.note: Changes to e before words starting with /i/ sound (i- or hi-).

examples.text: Servimos café caliente y pan fresco.
examples.trans: We serve hot coffee and fresh bread.

examples.text: Son las siete y cuarto.
examples.trans: It is quarter past seven.
